 European Scouts Infiltrate RAMS Park Ahead of High-Stakes Intercontinental Derby
 By Emre Sarigul - October 26, 2026 
 Facebook X 
 Fenerbahçe, with top clubs targeting key talent on both sides of the rivalry.
 According to reports from A Spor commentator Haldun Domaç, scouting departments across major European leagues have dispatched representatives to RAMS Park specifically to evaluate Galatasaray’s Batrakov and Fenerbahçe’s Oğuz Aydın.
 The match carries major title implications early in the Süper Lig campaign:
 Galatasaray: Sitting 2nd with 19 points, Cimbom aim to secure all three points to reclaim top spot in the league table.
 Fenerbahçe: Occupying 3rd place with 16 points, the visitors seek to draw level on points with their fiercest rivals.

 Galatasaray enter the fixture boasting an extraordinary 39-match unbeaten streak at home in Süper Lig action, dating back to late in the 2023–24 campaign. Referee Atilla Karaoğlan will officiate the match, which kicks off at 21:30 local time.
